evidence.title: Hunter movement by road, rail, and sea
evidence.excerpt: A hunter move action changes the hunter location by road, rail, or sea. Road movement moves along one connected road route to an adjacent city. A hunter can reserve a ticket as a separate action by drawing ticket options and keeping a legal ticket according to the rules. Sea movement lets a hunter move between a port and an adjacent sea zone, or between connected sea zones, and usually causes damage or risk because hunters are vulnerable while traveling by sea. Hunters at sea have limited action options and often must keep moving until they return to land. Movement can trigger encounters, reveal information, or force combat if the hunter enters Dracula location or a space containing an encounter token.
